options.better_fit: The new UI fits Foundry project work such as discovering models and building agents.

feedback.intrinsic: The developer may not find non-project resource types and could waste time looking in the wrong interface.
feedback.instructional: Use the new UI for Foundry projects. Switch to classic when the work involves other resource types.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Use the new UI for projects, classic for other resource types, and switch when the work changes.

payload.prompt: A support engineer is helping an AI team during deployment and evaluation. Which tasks fit Ask AI?

options.rationale: Ask AI can troubleshoot issues across Microsoft Foundry. It is designed to answer questions and help with tasks.
Ask AI can help manage model deployments, quotas, and operations. That matches deployment support in Foundry.
Ask AI can interpret monitoring dashboards. This helps users understand operations after deployment.

options.error_type: confuses help feature with workspace organization
options.rationale: Ask AI is a help experience that uses specialized sub-agents. It does not replace Foundry projects, which are workspaces inside a Foundry resource.
options.better_fit: Foundry projects fit when a team needs workspaces for agents, evaluations, files, datasets, indexes, flows, connections, and settings.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would lose the workspace structure needed to organize deployment and evaluation work.
feedback.instructional: Ask AI supports people with guidance and tasks. Projects remain the workspaces where solution assets are built and managed.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Ask AI supports troubleshooting, deployment and quota help, dashboard interpretation, and evaluation workflows.

flashcards.back: Azure resource providing Foundry platform capabilities and model hosting.
A workspace inside a Foundry resource for AI solution assets.
Use it for Foundry projects and multi-agent application work.
A Foundry help experience using specialized sub-agents.
